business_summary: Shenzhen Cotran New Material Co.,Ltd. research and development, production, and sales of polymer materials and thermal management system products in China. It offers insulation waterproof tapes, fireproof boards/blankets/tapes, and other fireproof plugging products; rubber adhesive tapes, PVC insulation tapes, and cold shrink tubing products; electronic moisture-proof plugging products, and automotive door and window sealing strips; and heat dissipation metal structural components, including liquid cooling plates for power batteries in new energy vehicles, condensers and evaporators. The company products are used in communications, power, new energy vehicles, traditional home appliances, automobiles, data centers, mining, and rail transportation industries. Shenzhen Cotran New Material Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
